title: "test"
output: html_document

```{r}
# Load necessary library
library(ggplot2)

# Generate left-skewed data using a transformation
set.seed(123) # For reproducibility
left_skewed_data <- rbeta(1000, shape1 = 5, shape2 = 2) * 50 # Adjusting range

# Create a histogram
ggplot(data.frame(x = left_skewed_data), aes(x)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "blue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  ggtitle("Histogram of Left-Skewed Data") +
  xlab("Values") +
  ylab("Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()
```
